He is the first Grand Tour debutant with three stage wins since Tadej Pogacar in La Vuelta 19.
He is the first sprinter to claim three stage wins in his maiden Grand Tour since Fernando Gaviria in the Giro 2017. The Colombian even pushed his tally to four wins on that occasion.
And he continues to fuel the comparisons with Peter Sagan, who won three stages in his first Grand Tour, La Vuelta 11."],"pinned":false,"createdBy":"bvittek","updatedAt":"2026-09-03T12:53:24+02:00","updatedBy":"bvittek","title":"Brennan in the footsteps of Pogacar, Gaviria and Sagan","locale":"en","publicationAt":"2026-09-03T12:53:24+02:00","stage":12,"slug":"brennan-in-the-footsteps-of-pogacar-gaviria-and-sagan","stageType":"HMG","_id":"91b52f6a581d92dd77c22c01e42de73c6a95be2132acaf652f5db2e7ba252f6e","_bind":"publication_en-2026-12","_origin":"news-2026-12","_updatedAt":1788432804590,"_parent":"stage-2026:2b04ffe490dd4bf9e3918b4334bc27f01bcc349c9637fb83ce90e60917ed5b5d","_key":"_id","_virtual":"news:brennan-in-the-footsteps-of-pogacar-gaviria-and-sagan","model":"news"},{"updatedAt":"2026-09-03T09:29:19+02:00","title":"Predict today's stage winner with Cofidis","id":186,"url":"vuelta26-predictor-uk","contentId":"91iabrFF","locale":"en","text":["Predict today's stage winner with Cofidis"],"type":"fastory","image":"https://img.aso.fr/core_app/img-cycling-vue-png/picto-cofidis-400x400/28518/0:0,400:400-0-0-70/78002","_id":"cd09535fff6ab63a466e9dfed8b4f501fb5253d99d58d09f0a48f78eb17c26df","_bind":"publication_en-2026-12","_origin":"interactiveContent-2026-12","_updatedAt":1788420559620,"_parent":"stage-2026:2b04ffe490dd4bf9e3918b4334bc27f01bcc349c9637fb83ce90e60917ed5b5d","_key":"_id","_virtual":"interactiveContent:enfastory-186","model":"interactive","isClub":false},{"id":1806,"createdBy":"ganz","stage":{"timezone":"Europe/Madrid","date":"2026-09-03T00:00:00+02:00","type":"HMG","stage":12,"lengthDisplay":166.6,"length":166.6,"showGroups":true,"isCancelled":false,"podiumDisplayMode":"instantpodium"},"pinned":false,"updatedAt":"2026-09-03T14:03:25+02:00","onlyClubTab":false,"onlyDataTab":false,"embedCode":"

[We need] to have him in the breakaway and hopefully with one more from the team so we can maintain a high speed, we want the breakaway to go as early as possible because then you get a bigger gap. This is his last Grand Tour before retiring.
“Of course [I’d like to secure a stage win in La Vuelta to complete my victories in all three Grand Tours], but I wouldn’t say I’m going to go mad about it either”, the Basque climber said today at the start. “I don’t want to become obsessed with this goal and neglect the work I’m doing for the team, which I believe is key.
